purpose: Truth-free audit of the sole Phase56 next factor PseudorangeRateUncertaintyMetersPerSecond, including its relation to the source-sign-consistent raw code/rate closure and its material effect relative to the actual native FGO Doppler sigma paths.

objective.implementation_if_all_gates_pass: separate freeze only; opt-in FGO Doppler sigma floor max(existing_doppler_sigma_mps, raw_rate_uncertainty_mps), coefficient 1, no cap, FGO only and no SPP
objective.implementation_if_any_gate_fails: no C++ change; preserve Phase43 champion and Phase51 experimental option

phase56_policy_record.use: policy metadata only; no Phase56 metric payload is read by the Phase57 raw evaluator

phase56_output_result.use: policy metadata only; not an audit metric input

phase25_raw_clock_contract.use: Phase25 raw pseudorange reconstruction contract only

phase41_rate_contract.use: source sign/unit policy only; no metric payload
phase41_rate_contract.sign_contract: Android PseudorangeRateMetersPerSecond is range-rate m/s and the adapter D=-raw_rate/wavelength; raw rate enters the trapezoidal P increment directly

phase13_upstream_quality_policy.policy: do not reproduce fixed upstream residual thresholds or truth-tuned selection

raw_schema.row_filter: Only MessageType=Raw rows are parsed; non-Raw rows are counted and excluded; enriched coordinate fields are never parsed.

fixed_equations.raw_pseudorange: Phase25 long-double-equivalent P=(tow_rx-tow_tx)*c using integer/Decimal segment-base receiver TOW, BiasNanos, TimeOffsetNanos, constellation mapping, and nearest-week unwrap.
fixed_equations.transition_domain: Same system/SVID/signal consecutive Raw epochs with dt strictly >0 and <=1.5 s, unchanged HardwareClockDiscontinuityCount and segment, valid Android code/transmit state, finite PseudorangeRateMetersPerSecond, finite in-range P, and existing MultipathIndicator/Cn0 masks clear.
fixed_equations.raw_code_rate_residual: e_k=(P_k-P_prev)-0.5*(PseudorangeRateMetersPerSecond_prev+PseudorangeRateMetersPerSecond_k)*dt_seconds; raw rate enters directly with the Phase41 sign/unit contract.
fixed_equations.clock_center: For each endpoint utcTimeMillis and HCDC group, subtract the median e_k across comparable eligible transitions; retain raw and centered values. Absolute centered residual is the relation metric.
fixed_equations.normalized_residual: abs(centered_residual_m)/pair_integrated_sigma_m for finite positive endpoint uncertainties only.
fixed_equations.fixed_uncertainty_bins: <=0.1 m/s, 0.1_to_0.5 m/s, 0.5_to_2 m/s, >2 m/s; equality belongs to the lower closed bin.
fixed_equations.spearman: Tie-averaged rank correlation between u_pair_mps and absolute centered closure residual, finite positive pair uncertainty only.
fixed_equations.configured_fixed_sigma: Existing undifferenced FGO sigma lower bound is max(1e-4,0.2 m/s); actual elevation penalty can only increase it. Single-difference diagnostic floor is hypot(0.2,0.2)=0.2828427125 m/s before elevation.
fixed_equations.configured_snr_sigma: When use_upstream_observable_quality is enabled, reproduce only the source-exact D sigma path: snrScale=10^(-(Cn0DbHz-p85_band)/20), sigma_D=snrScale/12; p85 is source linearPercentile at configured percentile 85. No truth or tuned threshold.
fixed_equations.affected_factor_proxy: For each eligible current raw Doppler row, affected_fixed_lower_bound is u_current_mps>0.2; affected_snr_enabled is u_current_mps>source-exact SNR D sigma. Report both; no elevation/nav is inferred.
fixed_equations.displacement_potential_proxy: For each affected fixed-lower-bound row, max(0,u_current_mps-0.2)*1.0 s in metres; report route p95 and median. This is a one-second measurement-uncertainty proxy, not a trajectory or horizontal estimate.
fixed_equations.loo: For each omitted route, recompute pooled uncertainty bins, Spearman, high-vs-low p95 relation, and direction; no correction or inference output.

fgo_adoption_contract.current_factor_lane: native FGO undifferenced Doppler factors with existing configured sigma; corrected Earth-rotation branch may be enabled by caller
fgo_adoption_contract.scope_if_authorized: all Android raw signals that actually enter FGO Doppler factors; FGO only, no SPP

existing_masks.invalid_state: missing code-lock or transmit-time state bits

numeric_gates.logic: AND; all thresholds and roles are immutable after this freeze and before the one-shot raw read

composition_independence.if_single_family: fail composition gate; do not infer signal-independent mechanism

controls_and_repeats.truth_free_control: raw closure residual without uncertainty weighting/correction
controls_and_repeats.candidate_concept: not applied during audit; only raw sigma/factor-impact proxy

source_decision_policy.if_all_gates_pass: Authorize a separately frozen implementation of the exact FGO-only sigma floor; do not run truth in Phase57.
source_decision_policy.if_any_gate_fails: No C++ change. Record strongest raw-only structure and exactly one next source-supported physical factor.
source_decision_policy.field_unavailable: No correction; fail closed and report field/header/finite coverage separately.
